Williams and Ronald Greeley of Arizona State University. Thus the organization credit is historically supported. nativeAssessment.limitations: Monochrome processed close-up panels, black strip gaps/seams, panel outlines, 5 km scale bar, locator lines and globe inset are publisher measurement/presentation context, not a seamless texture or calibrated visible colour. No local mass fractions are measured by this image. Caption-estimated knobs 80–100 m high and ~3 m discernible features are source statements, not new raster/angular calculations. Sublimation, dust migration and impact-ejecta origins are interpretations/hypotheses; no unique chemistry or present-day activity rate established.
nativeAssessment.preservation: Exact NASA-served JPEG bytes retained without editing; no embedding or replacement of an existing asset in this batch. Direct JPL caption and CloudFront JPEG requests returned HTTP403, documented with null hashes; NASA asset alternative succeeded.
